name: bld5_pisano_lucas_even_eq
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (he : Even n) : p3_pisano (p3_lucas n) = 4 * n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (he : Even n), p3_pisano (p3_lucas n) = 4 * n
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld4_pisano_lucas_dvd_four_mul, Mathlib2.lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period, Mathlib2.lib_fib_cassini_cast and Mathlib2.lib_p3_lucas_cast: π := pisano(L_n) ∣ 4n by the bld4 theorem. By lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period (i = 0) L_n ∣ F_π; also L_n ∣ F_{2n} (Nat.fib_two_mul), so by Nat.fib_gcd L_n ∣ F_g with g = gcd(π, 2n) ∣ 2n; since F_{n+1} < L_n ≤ F_g forces g ≥ n+2 > n, g = 2n, i.e. 2n ∣ π. So π ∈ {2n, 4n}. If π = 2n then (lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period, i = 1) F_{2n+1} ≡ 1 mod L_n; but F_{2n+1} = F_{n+1}·L_n − (−1)^n (from lib_p3_lucas_cast, Nat.fib_two_mul_add_one and lib_fib_cassini_cast), which is ≡ −1 for even n, giving L_n ∣ 2, false as L_n ≥ 3.
source: builds on Mathlib2.bld4_pisano_lucas_dvd_four_mul, Mathlib2.lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period, Mathlib2.lib_fib_cassini_cast, Mathlib2.lib_p3_lucas_cast
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → Even n → Mathlib2.p3_pisano (Mathlib2.p3_lucas n) = 4 * n
